observations: Inspected all 60 raw and RGB prepared glyphs before training. No blank RGB foreground seen.
RGB preserves sampled ordinary and equal-luminance colored glyph structure. Noise and crossing lines remain.

ambiguities.observation: Crossing line adds a tail to printed zero, making it look somewhat nine-like.
Handwritten eight has a B-like shape.
Open handwritten four can look h-like.
Handwritten seven has a nearly vertical shape that can resemble one.

decision: Keep predeclared source labels and frozen data; no samples relabelled or removed from this inspection. Ambiguity limits interpretation.
